ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee as a Ryde voucher and remind the driver that the "I'm Here" no-show flow requires the tap and the continuous >3-minute wait to count from the tap itself.
ruling.reasoning:
Screening: chat messages [F9][F10] and the driver's statement [F12] contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; dispute type is no_show, not safety. safety_concern = none.

This is a driver-cancelled no-show claim, so NS-0 routes it to NS-1/NS-2.

NS-1 requires all three: (i) "I'm Here" tapped; (ii) at the tap the driver within 200 m of pickup; (iii) a continuous wait at the pickup point of more than 3 minutes measured from the tap.
- (i) satisfied: tap at 17:19:15 [F6].
- (ii) satisfied: 41 m from pickup at tap [F6].
- (iii) fails. Within-200 m time after the tap was 3 min 40 s [F6] — that is > 3:00 but does not reach the policy's ≥ 3:01 threshold, i.e. "waited for more than 3 minutes". The driver's own message "3 min up, cancelling the trip" [F10] and the cancellation 5 min 5 s after platform-recorded arrival [F5] confirm he treated exactly 3 minutes as sufficient, which is one second short of the required wait.

The 5 min 5 s cumulative time within 200 m before cancellation [F2] cannot supply the missing second: NS-1 (iii) counts only waiting after the tap, and the pre-tap stationing at 17:17:50–17:19:15 [F2][F3] is expressly excluded. The driver's statement that he "waited over 3 minutes" [F12] is a statement and is overridden by the timeline [F6]. Note also this case shows the arrival confirmation was a driver_tap [F6], not a platform_auto.

Because NS-1 (iii) is not met, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full (refund_full, $6.61). The NS-2 flag trigger — a tap made while GPS showed the driver outside 200 m — does not apply, since 41 m ≤ 200 m [F6]; no flag_account. The driver's 2 previously upheld no-show disputes [F17] are profile facts and cannot decide this case; the NS-2 flag clause is not triggered, so no account flag.

Evidence is sufficient: GPS is continuous and covers the cancellation moment [F3][F5][F6], every chat message is timestamped [F11], and no needed record is missing.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement claims he 'waited over 3 minutes', but timeline/GPS records show only 3 min 40 s within 200 m after the tap [F6], and system records override statements; the >3-minute requirement of NS-1 (iii) is met only from 3:01, which the record does not establish.

Cumulative 5 min 5 s within 200 m before cancellation is not usable for NS-1 (iii); the clause counts only the continuous wait measured from the 'I'm Here' tap, and the pre-tap period 17:17:50–17:19:15 is excluded.

Driver's 3 disputes / 2 no-show upholdings in 90 days is a profile fact; profile facts cannot alone decide a case, and the NS-2 account flag requires a tap made outside the 200 m pickup radius, which did not occur (41 m, [F6]).
